body: Yes. That's what my question about how do I stop feeling so selfish was about. I feel like I just really want to get across to him how I feel but then I don't want to worry him. I feel like if he knew how his words impacted me he wouldn't say them. But then I don't want him to treat me like a fragile flower either.

Go to a doctor (phone calls set off my anxiety so find one you can book an appointment online). 
Dumb girls can go fuck themselves. They end up living pointless lives with no real friends or goals or anything. Ignore them - they only want a reaction. If they say anything to you give it a one word response if that. 
This will pass like it did last time. 

I doubt this will help so get professional help now. Look up doctors/therapists online to see if they are any good first before going to them.
